description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class 'PurgeServiceTest' for testing the 'PurgeService' in the OrangeHRM system, focusing on data purging functionalities such as employee and candidate data. It includes setup methods, multiple test cases for verifying purging strategies, handling of exceptions, and specific data cleanup scenarios.

classes.name: PurgeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies various functionalities of the PurgeService, including data purging for employees and candidates, strategy retrieval, and exception handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of PurgeService, setting up fixture data, and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeePurgeDao
methods.description: Tests that getPurgeDao returns an instance of PurgeDao.

methods.name: testGetPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Verifies that the method returns the correct list of purgeable entities for a specific strategy.

methods.name: testGetPurgeStrategy
methods.description: Checks that the correct purge strategy instance is returned when asked, along with verifying its match-by values and parameters.

methods.name: testGetPurgeStrategy2
methods.description: Verifies that a different purge strategy (Destroy) is returned correctly, with proper match-by values and null parameters.

methods.name: testPurgeEmployeeData
methods.description: Tests the complete employee data purge process, including data transformation and cleanup, asserting that employee and related entities' data are Purged.

methods.name: testPurgeEmployeeDataWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures that a TransactionException is thrown if an error occurs during employee data purge.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy1
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data for a vacancy where all candidates have not consented to data retention.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy2
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data for a vacancy where all candidates have consented to keep data.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy3
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data when no candidates have applied for that vacancy.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy4
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data where some candidates have consented and others have not, verifying selective deletion.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy5
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data when a candidate has started an interview process.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures that a TransactionException is thrown if an error occurs during candidate data purge.
